This is the exact Elsevier CAS 2.4 archive selected by the author:

https://assets.ctfassets.net/o78em1y1w4i4/5uFmLZJTPDMAUjFnHRpjj8/6f19a979146eb93263763d87a894ab0d/els-cas-templates.zip

The project-root files `cas-dc.cls`, `cas-sc.cls`, `cas-common.sty`, and
`cas-model2-names.bst` are unmodified copies from this archive. Their class date
is 2024/05/04. Exact checksums are recorded in `provenance.json`.

This directory preserves the original README, manifest, two template sources,
documentation source, and optional thumbnail images. It is a documentation
subset, not the full upstream sample-image and sample-PDF collection. Copyright
and LPPL notices remain in all copied files. The manuscript uses CAS's `nologo`
option for email metadata; none of the thumbnail images is needed to build it.

The earlier `docs/vendor/elsarticle/` directory is retained for provenance of
the archived pre-CAS version and is not used by the current build.
